biw_news.title: VW Group Delays SSP Platform Rollout, Impacting Next-Gen Audi A4 e-tron
biw_news.summary: Volkswagen Group has pushed back the launch of its next-generation Scalable Systems Platform (SSP) production target to 2029. The delay directly impacts Audi's unified EV body engineering and architecture standardization across future luxury segment vehicles.

biw_news.title: McLaren Prepares New Multi-Material Architecture and SUV Platform
biw_news.summary: McLaren plans to retire its current mid-engine model lineup by 2028 to make way for next-generation sports car and SUV platforms. The roadmap highlights evolving carbon-fiber tub engineering and flexible multi-material structural packaging.

biw_news.title: Volvo Standardizes SPA2 and SPA3 Platforms for 13 New Global Models
biw_news.summary: Volvo announced a 13-model expansion anchored by its SPA2 and SPA3 modular architectures. The platform strategy allows flexible structural integration for BEV, PHEV, and HEV drivetrains across both low- and high-body vehicle silhouettes.

biw_news.title: Stellantis Demonstrates Multi-Energy Flexibility on STLA Large Platform
biw_news.summary: The new Dodge Charger showcases the structural versatility of the STLA Large platform, engineered to accommodate both battery-electric systems and internal combustion inline-six engines. The shared body-in-white structure demonstrates multi-powertrain chassis integration.

biw_news.title: VW Mission Efficiency Concept Explores Lightweight Aero-Driven Body Design
biw_news.summary: Volkswagen unveiled the Mission Efficiency concept, combining ultra-low aerodynamic drag body principles from the historic XL1 with modern EV floorpans. The development underscores structural weight optimization to extend battery range.

biw_news.title: Audi Revives A2 Lineage with High-Efficiency Compact EV Architecture
biw_news.summary: Audi's upcoming A2 e-tron revisits the lightweight ethos of the original Spaceframe A2 using modern compact electric vehicle platform engineering. The design focuses on body efficiency and dense battery packaging to deliver up to 400 miles of range.
